title: Total units
context: Ops wants the total number of units across all orders.
task: Find the total of F2:F41.

title: Average unit price
context: Pricing wants the mean list price on orders.
task: Find the average of G2:G41.

title: How many orders?
context: A KPI tile needs the order count.
task: Find the count of numeric values in A2:A41.

title: How many reps listed?
context: HR wants a headcount from the Reps table.
task: Find the number of non-empty cells in N2:N7.

title: Largest single order (units)
context: Which order had the most units?
task: Find the largest value in F2:F41.

title: Cheapest product cost
context: Procurement wants the lowest unit cost in the Products table.
task: Find the smallest value in L2:L9.

title: Revenue for one order
context: Row 2 is a single order; compute its value.
task: Multiply Units (F2) by UnitPrice (G2).

title: Margin per unit
context: Practise subtracting two cells: the list price on row 2 minus the Widget cost.
task: Return G2 minus L2.

title: 10% discount
context: A promo gives 10% off the unit price.
task: Return G2 reduced by 10%.

title: Rounded average price
context: The dashboard shows two decimals.
task: Find the average of G2:G41, rounded to 2 decimal places.

title: Big or small order
context: Flag orders with 6 or more units as Bulk.
task: For row 2 return "Bulk" if F2 >= 6, otherwise "Standard".

title: Delivered flag
context: A helper column marks delivered orders with 1.
task: For row 3 return 1 if Status (H3) equals "Delivered", else 0.

title: Delivered orders
context: Ops tracks fulfilment.
task: Count how many orders have Status "Delivered" (H2:H41).

title: Orders over 8 units
context: How many orders are large?
task: Count orders where Units (F2:F41) is greater than 8.

title: Units sold in the North
context: The North regional manager wants their unit volume.
task: Sum Units (F2:F41) where Region (C2:C41) is "North".

title: Units for Widgets
context: Product manager for Widget wants volume.
task: Sum Units where Product (E2:E41) is "Widget".

title: Average units per Gadget order
context: How big is a typical Gadget order?
task: Average Units (F2:F41) where Product is "Gadget".

title: Uppercase region
context: Labels on the chart are in caps.
task: Return the Region in C2 in upper case.

title: Length of a product name
context: Checking label widths.
task: Return the number of characters in E2.

title: Order label
context: Build a label like "1001 - Widget".
task: Concatenate A2, the text " - ", and E2.

title: First three letters
context: A short code for the region.
task: Return the first 3 characters of C2.

title: Clean a messy name
context: Row 6 has a rep name with stray spaces and wrong case.
task: Return D6 trimmed of extra spaces and converted to Proper Case.

title: Order year
context: Finance groups orders by year.
task: Return the year of the date in B2.

title: Order month
context: Monthly reporting.
task: Return the month number of the date in B2.

title: Days between two orders
context: How many days separate order 1001 and order 1002?
task: Return B3 minus B2 (dates are serial numbers, so subtraction gives days).

title: Build a date
context: A fixed reporting date.
task: Return the date 31 March 2024 using DATE.

title: Look up a product's category
context: Add the category next to an order.
task: Using VLOOKUP on the Products table (J2:L9), return the Category for the product in E2 (exact match).

title: Look up a rep's target
context: Compare each rep to target.
task: Return the Target from the Reps table (N2:Q7) for the rep in D2 (exact match).
hint: Target is the 3rd column of N2:Q7.

title: Price range
context: Spread between most and least expensive list price.
task: Return MAX of G2:G41 minus MIN of G2:G41.

title: Both conditions
context: North region AND delivered.
task: For row 2, return TRUE if C2 is "North" AND H2 is "Delivered", else FALSE.

title: Either condition
context: Cancelled or Returned means lost revenue.
task: For row 2, return TRUE if H2 is "Cancelled" OR "Returned".

title: Any missing statuses?
context: Data-quality check on the Status column.
task: Find the number of blank cells in H2:H41.

title: Share of total units
context: What fraction of all units is in order 1001?
task: Return F2 divided by the sum of F2:F41.

title: Even or odd order number
context: Alternate row shading uses even/odd IDs.
task: Return the remainder when A2 is divided by 2.
